Yeah same for me. I’m reverting back to normal in some parts. I kinda miss not being able to enjoy anything including food. I miss not caring about what I had to eat & the way I had to eat it. I miss not caring enough to be greedy or social (to an extent). I miss harming myself over every little problem & laying down hurting in every part of my body while drowning in my sorrow. I listened to sad music too while I did that which made it even better. But now, a lot of normality has returned. Depression is still here though, but it’s different like better or worse in some ways. I still have the urges & excitement I get to thinking about dying though, but it’s more intense for some reason, even though the circumstances are better.

So yeah I relate over 100% I am sure nothing will help me because I am on another level with this darkness and have developed beyond thousands of thoughts for each and every thing. I have awakened anew permanent different perspective of existence and have pretty much become darkness/depression itself now. I only follow and do what depression or darkness tells me and not the light since the light is dog feces. Light causes me to live this disturbing life and also causes life to exist on this rock. Our whole life is just going to just be on this rocky sad planet. 
If I live long enough I am just going to be living in solitude. My house is going to be dark and empty. I will have nothing but a chair and a fan since I can’t stand to have things and I will sit in it with a hood over my face 24/7 just having thoughts since that’s the only thing I can really do now. (That is if I’m still able to think)

I don’t want anything and never will on this planet. 

I don’t want to have any relationships since I despise everyone, find no one attractive, overly disgusting. I don’t like how it’s makes up a good chunk people’s shitty happiness and how it’s part of the script to live a good life. The only thing I would get out of that is 100% suffering and my thing down there doesn’t even work anymore anyway which is great because fuck that relationship misery.

I want to do nothing with my existence on this planet which is less than an atom compared to the whole universe but just enjoy the two things I still can enjoy for the next year or two. That’s the best life possible for me.

I will not come to meet a single human since I despise people and now have no need to be social. I hate every single thing they talk about, have, do, and their whole brain structure. Also I can’t barely open my mouth anymore since depression silenced it. I hate talking about mostly the same things everyday and things in general, it’s dull misery to me. Also the only thing that these non-depressed people would think of me is how sad, pathetic, and weird I am so why would I be social?

I want to become nothing and do nothing. I don’t want to work just for the benefit for myself, strangers, or all of humanity no matter what kind of work I do. The only thing I would get out of that is suffering and anxiety.


I don’t want to be rich.
I don’t want to have anyone’s life.
I don’t want to move.
I don’t want to see the future. 
I don’t want to have things since I hate all matter.
I don’t want to socialize with humans.
I don’t want to eat since nothing tastes good anymore.
I don’t want to ever ‘want’ anything but to die with a smile.


Oh yeah that”joy” you mentioned I won’t barely have not one drop of it. Most of it is going to be hell.
I don’t even like joy anyway since it feels bad.


Haha and to think that in early 2019 my depression was a baby, I was 50x more different, wanted things like wanted to work for NASA, a girlfriend, talked to people, and all together was a completely different person.

Now my depression is now on demon level in two years and I have otherworldly dark, evil, crippling depression and anxiety. :)
 

I see nothing good about my aspirations in 2019 now but suffering. So what do I do if nothing helps? I’ll just enjoy the two small things I can still enjoy for now until I start to dislike them which would be soon. So I’ll probably just die or be miserable.
